tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_3.csv')
# median-based robust z-score per group
def medz(s):
    med = s.median()
    mad = (s - med).abs().median()
    return (s - med) / (1.4826 * mad)
df['z'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform(medz)
top = df.reindex(df['z'].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index).head(15)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']])
